Chapter 3 · My family

3과 · 가족이에요sam-gwa · ga-jo-gi-e-yo

This is my family.

Today we will learn to:
  • name the people in a family,
  • say who is in a family with 있어요 and 없어요,
  • choose 오빠, 형, 언니, or 누나.

What does 나비 call him? Guess in the chat!

Presentation · 표현 1

N이/가 있어요 · 없어요i/ga i-sseo-yo · eop-sseo-yo · I have / I don’t have

✓ 있어요
i-sseo-yo · there is, I have
✗ 없어요
eop-sseo-yo · there isn’t, I don’t have

Before 있어요 and 없어요, add 이 or 가. Check the last syllable, just like 이에요/예요:

Ends in a consonant: add 이
동생 → 동생이 있어요
dong-saeng-i i-sseo-yo · I have a younger sibling.
Ends in a vowel: add 가
언니 → 언니가 없어요
eon-ni-ga eop-sseo-yo · I don’t have an older sister.

Presentation · 표현 2

오빠, 형, 언니, 누나o-ppa, hyeong, eon-ni, nu-na · Who is talking?

Older brotherOlder sisterYounger brother or sister
A girl says 오빠
o-ppa
 언니
eon-ni
 동생
dong-saeng
everyone
A boy says 형
hyeong
 누나
nu-na
Tip: Look at who is talking, not at the brother or sister.

Production · 어휘 플러스

Pets and grandparents

강아지가 있어요?
gang-a-ji-ga i-sseo-yo? · Do you have a puppy?
Answer in the chat: 네, 강아지가 있어요. or 아니요, 강아지가 없어요.

Production · 말하기

Be the character!

Draw a card to start.

Production · 한국 문화

Not only for family

In Korea, you can call an older friend 언니, 오빠, 형, or 누나. Fans call older idols 오빠 or 언니 too!

벨라 is younger than 하늘. They are friends. What can 벨라 call 하늘?
하늘 오빠
ha-neul o-ppa
아론 is younger than 하늘. They are friends. What can 아론 call 하늘?
하늘 형
ha-neul hyeong
